_comment: Single source of truth for WHO counts as me and HOW languages are filtered. collect-stats.mjs reads this.
_authorEmails: Every email you have ever committed under. GraphQL counts a commit as MINE if its author email is in this list, so it catches commits made under emails that are NOT linked to your GitHub account (e.g. viethq@tedi.com.vn). Add any missing email here rather than editing numbers by hand.
_ignoreLanguages: Prose / markup excluded from the language mix, mirroring metrics.yml so the README card and the numbers agree.
_activeSince: Earliest year to report on the site counter. Left explicit so an old imported repo cannot drag it backwards.
